interface.title: DataProcess (bioelectronics_toolkit v0.7.0)
interface.field: Bioelectronics: electrophysiology, electrochemistry and fluorescence imaging
interface.stage_of_work: Primary analysis of raw instrument recordings: inspection, event detection, ROI quantification, figure/CSV export and provenance
interface.what_it_is_for: A local web workbench where a researcher points at a server-side folder of ABF, electrochemistry CSV or TIFF recordings, detects peaks, paired events or ROI intensities, exports CSV/PNG/SVG/GIF, and gets an automatic run manifest for each export so it can be reproduced.

data.note: Bundled examples/ folder (sample_patch_clamp.abf, sample_echem_photocurrent.csv, sample_fluorescence_stack.tif). Folders were entered by the dashboard demo links (?demo=abf|echem|fluorescence), by 'Use examples' plus Refresh, or by typing 'examples'. The app has no upload control, and every export is written into examples/ on the server; nothing reached the browser's downloads. The ABF CSV export (sample_patch_clamp_s1_ch0.csv) then showed up in the EChem file list.
